propositions: A new 'surface-parity' overlay must be added to the code-review gate that detects when a write-op parameter, guard, or required-field surface changes on one adapter (CLI, MCP, or lib) without matching updates to the sibling adapters.
The overlay must fire only on glob patterns matching the three write-surface adapters (_commands/*, _lib_writes.py, _mcp_writes.py) and remain inert on unrelated diffs.
The overlay must be advisory (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) with false-positive guards for deliberate justified divergence, adapter-bound params, and internal refactors.
The overlay must be wired into both round_a and round_b batches of the code-review.yaml gate so the finder is actually dispatched, not merely flagged.
The base-reviewer overlay catalog in code-review-base.md must enumerate 'surface-parity' and pass the strict drift test test_base_prompt_enumerates_exactly_the_overlay_ids.

The packaged reviewer prompt must use the deletion-impact/api-compat contract (evidence-record findings, criteria=['surface-parity'], no model-emitted severity) and reviewers/index.json must remain unchanged (overlays excluded from the selection catalog).
